nasreth_the_soul_harrower.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——费用0：攻击
当纳塞斯命中英雄时，放逐其灵魂中的一张牌。若以此方式放逐的是一张光牌，获得1点生命。
nasreth_the_soul_harrower.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - 0: Attack
When Nasreth hits a hero, banish a card from their soul. If a Light card is banished this way, gain 1{h}.

nasty_surprise.text_zh: 当对手的效果将此牌从任何区域置入你的坟场时，创造敏捷、力量、活力衍生物各一个。
nasty_surprise.text_en: When an opponent's effect puts this into your graveyard from anywhere, create an Agility, Might, and Vigor token.

natures_path_pilgrimage.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次武器攻击获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中且你军械库中没有牌时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为行动牌，将其牌面朝下放入你的军械库。”
再动
natures_path_pilgrimage.text_en:
Your next weapon attack this turn gets +3{p} and "When this hits and you have no cards in your arsenal, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an action card, put it face down into your arsenal."
Go again

nebula_blade.type_zh: 符文剑士 武器·剑 （双手）
nebula_blade.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
当此牌命中时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
若本回合你使用过一张非攻击行动牌，此牌获得+3力量。
nebula_blade.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
When this hits, create a Runechant token.
If you've played a non-attack action card this turn, this gets +3{p}.

nebula_duality.type_zh: 闪电 法师 行动
nebula_duality.text_zh:
对任意目标造成3点秘法伤害。
瞬间——支付1点资源，弃掉此牌：对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。创造一个闪电流转衍生物。
nebula_duality.text_en:
Deal 3 arcane damage to any target.
Instant - {r}, discard this: Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero. Create a Lightning Flow token.

nebulus_cycle.type_zh: 闪电 幻术师 瞬间·光环
nebulus_cycle.text_zh:
当此牌离开竞技场时，创造一个沉思衍生物。
结界2
nebulus_cycle.text_en:
When this leaves the arena, create a Ponder token.
Ward 2

nekria.text_zh: 每当内克里亚造成或受到伤害时，在其上放置一个-1生命指示物并创造一个灰烬衍生物。
nekria.text_en: Whenever Nekria deals or is dealt damage, put a -1{h} counter on her and create an Ash token.

nerve_scalpel.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
nerve_scalpel.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
穿透1
当此牌命中英雄时，本回合该英雄下一次用1张或更多反应牌防御时，那些牌在防御时获得-1防御。
nerve_scalpel.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
Piercing 1
When this hits a hero, the next time they defend with 1 or more reaction cards this turn, those cards have -1{d} while defending.

nerves_of_steel.text_zh:
当钢铁神经进入竞技场时，从你控制的一件胸部装备上移除一个-1防御指示物。
若你控制的装备防御力量为2或更低的攻击，其战痕和淬炼不触发。
当你的英雄受到伤害时，摧毁钢铁神经。
nerves_of_steel.text_en:
When Nerves of Steel enters the arena, remove a -1{d} counter from a chest equipment you control.
Battleworn and temper on equipment you control doesn't trigger if it defends an attack with 2 or less {p}.
When your hero is dealt damage, destroy Nerves of Steel.

nettling_shot.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
nettling_shot.text_zh: 当此牌被正面朝上放入你的军械库时，你可以横置目标盟友。
nettling_shot.text_en: When this is put face-up into your arsenal, you may {t} target ally.

never_give_up.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，将此牌置于你的牌库底：此链环中目标防御行动牌获得+3防御。仅当此牌在你坟场中、你的生命低于每位英雄且本回合你被欢呼过时才能启动此异能。
never_give_up.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, put this on the bottom of your deck: Target defending action card gets +3{d} this chain link. Activate this only while it's in your graveyard, you have less {h} than each hero, and you've been cheered this turn.

never_yield.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，摧毁永不退缩，然后若你手牌中没有牌，抽一张牌。若你的生命低于其他所有英雄，获得2点生命。若你控制的装备少于其他所有英雄，从你控制的一件装备上移除一个-1防御指示物。
never_yield.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy Never Yield then if you have no cards in hand, draw a card. If you have less {h} than all other heroes, gain 2{h}. If you control less equipment than all other heroes, remove a -1{d} counter from an equipment you control.

new_horizon.text_zh:
若你军械库中有一张正面朝上的牌，你拥有一个额外的军械库区域。
当此牌被摧毁时，摧毁你军械库中的所有牌。
刃碎
new_horizon.text_en:
If you have a face up card in your arsenal, you have an additional arsenal zone.
When this is destroyed, destroy all cards in your arsenal.
Blade Break

nights_embrace.text_zh: 本回合你的具有隐匿的攻击获得+1力量。
nights_embrace.text_en: Your attacks with stealth get +1{p} this turn.

nimble_strike.text_zh: 作为使用灵巧打击的额外费用，你可以放逐你坟场中一张名为轻灵之道的牌。若如此做，灵巧打击获得+1力量和再动。
nimble_strike.text_en: As an additional cost to play Nimble Strike, you may banish a card named Nimblism from your graveyard. If you do, Nimble Strike gain +1{p} and go again.

nimblism.text_zh:
你本回合使用的下一张费用为1或更低的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
再动
nimblism.text_en:
The next attack action card with cost 1 or less you play this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

nimby.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张轻灵之道，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
nimby.text_en: When this attacks, you may search your deck for a Nimblism, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

ninth_blade_of_the_blood_oath.name_en: Ninth Blade of the Blood Oath
ninth_blade_of_the_blood_oath.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
ninth_blade_of_the_blood_oath.text_zh: 每当你控制一个符文吟唱，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
ninth_blade_of_the_blood_oath.text_en: This costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control.

nip_at_the_heels.text_zh: 目标基础力量为3或更低的攻击获得+1力量。
nip_at_the_heels.text_en: Target attack with 3 or less base {p} gets +1{p}.

nitro_mechanoid.type_zh: 机械师 武器 装备·物品
nitro_mechanoid.text_zh:
行动——放逐硝基机甲下的一张牌：攻击
压制
淬炼
nitro_mechanoid.text_en:
Action - Banish a card from under Nitro Mechanoid: Attack
Overpower
Temper

nix_the_nimble.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的反应牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
nix_the_nimble.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' reaction cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

no_fear.text_zh:
作为使用此牌的额外费用，放逐你手牌中的任意数量力量为6或更高的牌。在结束阶段开始时，将它们移回你的手牌。
本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中X点伤害，X为2加上为使用此牌而放逐的牌数量。
no_fear.text_en:
As an additional cost to play this, banish any number of cards with 6 or more {p} from your hand. At the beginning of the end phase, return them to your hand.
The next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent X of that damage, where X is 2 plus the number of cards banished to play this.

no_hero_stands_alone.text_zh:
当此牌在任意区域时，若本回合你控制过坚韧衍生物，此牌获得+3防御和伏击。
当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。胜者可以选择让一张攻击或防御牌在此链环中获得-3力量和-3防御。
no_hero_stands_alone.text_en:
While this is in any zone, if you've controlled a Toughness token this turn, this gets +3{d} and ambush.
When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner may choose an attacking or defending card to get -3{p} -3{d} this chain link.

no_tall_tales.text_zh:
若此牌的力量大于其基础，它获得+1力量。
塔盾——若此牌的力量为13或更高，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄拥有的牌在其下一个行动阶段期间失去且不能获得再动。”
no_tall_tales.text_en:
If this has {p} greater than its base, it gets +1{p}.
Tower - If this has 13 or more {p}, it gets "When this hits a hero, cards they own lose and can't get go again during their next action phase."

nock_the_deathwhistle.text_zh:
阿泽利亚专精
从你的牌库中搜寻一张箭矢牌，展示它，然后洗牌并将其置于你的牌库顶。
装填
再动
nock_the_deathwhistle.text_en:
Azalea Specialization
Search your deck for an arrow card, reveal it, then shuffle your deck and put it on top of your deck.
Reload
Go again

nom_de_plume.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：每位英雄抽一张牌。再动
nom_de_plume.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Each hero draws a card.  Go again

northern_winds.text_zh:
奥德希姆专精
为每位英雄，冻结其控制的至多1件装备、物品和盟友，直到你的下一个回合开始。
团结——当此牌与一张来自手牌的牌一起防御时，在任意数量英雄的控制下创造一个法殁神盾衍生物。
northern_winds.text_en:
Oldhim Specialization
For each hero, freeze up to 1 equipment, item, and ally they control until the start of your next turn.
Unity - When this defends together with a card from hand, create a Spellbane Aegis token under any number of heroes' control.

not_so_fast.text_zh:
斯柯夫专精
本回合对手下一次将因金币衍生物的效果抽牌时，改为你抽一张牌。
not_so_fast.text_en:
Scurv Specialization
The next time an opponent would draw a card from the effect of a Gold token this turn, instead you draw a card.

not_so_mighty.text_zh: 当此牌防御憎恶英雄的攻击时，摧毁其控制的一个力量衍生物。若如此做，创造一个坚韧衍生物。
not_so_mighty.text_en: When this defends a Reviled hero's attack, destroy a Might token they control. If you do, create a Toughness token.

not_so_tuff.text_zh: 当此牌防御崇敬英雄的攻击时，摧毁其控制的一个坚韧衍生物。若如此做，创造一个力量衍生物。
not_so_tuff.text_en: When this defends a Revered hero's attack, destroy a Toughness token they control. If you do, create a Might token.

nourishing_emptiness.text_zh: 当你坟场中没有攻击行动牌时，滋养虚空具有支配，以及“若此牌命中，你的英雄直到回合结束获得+1智力。”
nourishing_emptiness.text_en: While there are no attack action cards in your graveyard, Nourishing Emptiness has dominate and "If this hits, your hero gains +1{i} until end of turn."

nourishing_glow.type_zh: 闪电 幻术师 瞬间·光环
nourishing_glow.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，获得1点生命。
结界1
nourishing_glow.text_en:
When this enters the arena, gain 1{h}.
Ward 1

nucleus_aetherbolt.text_zh:
对任意目标造成3点秘法伤害。
若此牌造成伤害，你可以横置你的英雄。若如此做，你的英雄对任意目标造成1点秘法伤害。
nucleus_aetherbolt.text_en:
Deal 3 arcane damage to any target.
If this deals damage, you may {t} your hero. If you do, your hero deals 1 arcane damage to any target.

null_shock.type_zh: 法师 瞬间·闪电 Instant
null_shock.text_zh:
凝合
若目标瞬间牌的费用小于本回合你对对手英雄造成的秘法伤害总量，无效它。
//
对任意目标造成1点秘法伤害。
null_shock.text_en:
Meld
If target instant card has cost less than the total arcane damage you've dealt to opposing heroes this turn, negate it.
//
Deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

null_time_zone.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有2个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
当此牌进入竞技场时，说出一张牌名。当此牌在竞技场中时，被说出的牌不能被资源或从手牌使用。
null_time_zone.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with 2 steam counters. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
When this enters the arena, name a card. The named card can't be pitched or played from hand while this is in the arena.

numbskull.text_zh: 当此牌在任意区域时，其使用费用、力量和防御不能被修改。
numbskull.text_en: While this is in any zone, its {r} cost to play, {p}, and {d} can't be modified.

numbskull_charm.type_zh: 崇敬 蛮将 瞬间
numbskull_charm.text_zh:
选择任意数量；
- 摧毁一个自信或力量衍生物。
- 观众为你欢呼。
- 资源你牌库顶的一张牌。若其力量为6或更高，创造一个活力衍生物。
numbskull_charm.text_en:
Choose any number;
- Destroy a Confidence or Might token.
- The crowd cheers you.
- Pitch the top card of your deck. If it has 6 or more {p}, create a Vigor token.

nuu.text_zh:
你的具有隐匿的攻击获得"当此链环结算时，放逐所有防御此牌的的行动牌。"
瞬间——支付3点资源：查看一位对手英雄牌库顶的一张牌。若其为蓝色，你可以放逐它。直到回合结束，你可以不支付费用使用该英雄放逐区中的蓝色牌。
nuu.text_en:
Your attacks with stealth get "When this chain link resolves, banish all action cards defending this."
Instant - {c}{c}{c}: Look at the top card of an opposing hero's deck. If it's blue, you may banish it. Until end of turn, you may play blue cards from that hero's banished zone without paying their {r} cost.

nuu_alluring_desire.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 英雄
nuu_alluring_desire.text_zh:
你的具有隐匿的攻击获得“当此链环结算时，放逐所有防御此牌的的行动牌。”
瞬间——支付3点资源：查看一位对手英雄牌库顶的一张牌。若其为蓝色，你可以放逐它。直到回合结束，你可以不支付费用使用该英雄放逐区中的蓝色牌。
nuu_alluring_desire.text_en:
Your attacks with stealth get "When this chain link resolves, banish all action cards defending this."
Instant - {c}{c}{c}: Look at the top card of an opposing hero's deck. If it's blue, you may banish it. Until end of turn, you may play blue cards from that hero's banished zone without paying their {r} cost.
